about: The measurable part of brief.md, read by hall-carpenter brief. The facts are Wikipedia's, 'Foguang Temple': seven bays by four, 34 by 17.7 m, an inner and an outer set of columns, bracket sets half as high as the column, a hipped roof. The span is between the centres of the corner columns, as a hall's front is measured.
